query: how long did it take to build
answer:
The Burj Khalifa took about six years to build. Excavation started in January 2004, and main construction began on 21 September 2004 [1]. The tower topped out on 17 January 2009 and the exterior was finished on 1 October 2009. It officially opened on 4 January 2010 [1][2]. Depending on whether you count from the start of excavation or from the start of main construction, that works out to roughly five and a half to six years.
